genxml.title: frame bytes and link context constants of the ColdFire L1 node and peer links
genxml.doc:
Constants of the PPP-style frame that the ColdFire L1 uses on its node link (the Bedrock UART) and on its RS-422 peer links. The frame bytes and the receive check value are shared by both links. The context values (body offset, growth limit, escape list) belong to the peer link and the node port's setup.
Grades: the byte values and context numbers are read from the L1 image's frame and link set-up code. The meaning given to each one is an inference unless the item says otherwise.
